chunks: And Allah has made for you from your houses a place of rest, and made for you from the hides of the cattle houses which you can lighten (carry) on the day of your travel and the day of your stay, and from their wool and fur and hair is furniture and goods for a time.

key_terms.سَكَنًا: a place of rest or dwelling

ai.seo_question: What types of dwellings and household items does Allah mention in Surah An-Nahl?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the divine provision of both stability and mobility, reflecting the practical needs of the early Muslim community during periods of migration and settlement. The distinction between permanent homes and portable tents underscores the versatility of Allah's blessings, accommodating both sedentary life and the transient nature of travel or warfare.
